title: Framework Singletons And Core De Sandwich
description:

CONTEXT — read in full, in this order:
1. The spicy-umbrella plan file above.
2. `.🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️master.md` — read in FULL, especially: the W0 note that `🧰️framework/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📜️script.ts` was ALREADY fixed once this initiative (search "generatedManifestPath") for the OLD sandwich layout — you will likely need to update this AGAIN once framework-core moves to the new shape, so read that history to avoid re-breaking it; the M8 ts-rs finding (search "M8 ts-rs") which confirmed framework-core is the ONE real active ts-rs codegen site in the repo and is explicitly "still old-shape" as of that finding — you are the ticket that changes that, so M8's retarget work becomes newly-applicable the moment you move this crate (consider whether to also do the ts-rs retarget yourself in this same ticket, since leaving the driver pointed at a stale path the moment you move the crate would be exactly the "silent type drift" risk M8's own ticket warned about — check M8's closed ticket for its exact reasoning first). Also read the recent M1-M4 notes (framework role discovery is now real).
3. `.🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️TEMPLATE.md` — taxonomy shape conventions.
4. `🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/📚️lib/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/🔣️taxonomy.json` and `🟦️discovery.ts` — shared vocabulary/discovery.
5. `🧰️framework/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/` (framework-core, 8.4k lines, 58 dependents per the plan's inventory) and the hash/editor/schema singleton crates (find their exact current paths — search `🧰️framework/🔨️modules/` for `#⃣hash`, `✍️editor`, and a schema-named dir) — read all of these in full before touching anything.

YOUR TASK: 
1. **Framework-core**: move `🧰️framework/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs` (currently 8.4k lines, ALREADY split into `🦀️{media,dwg,artifact,manifest,app,element_id,learn,kernel}.rs`-style topic files per an earlier W0 godfile-split — verify this split already happened before assuming you need to redo it) into the Shape V2 shape: `🧰️framework/📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs` + topic files as taxonomy `<topic>/🦀️component.rs` folders (per the SHAPE V2 amendment's explicit rule that "framework godfile splits... likewise become `<topic>/🦀️component.rs` folders"). This crate has **58 dependents** — this is the highest-blast-radius single file move in this ticket's scope; grep-verify every dependent's path BEFORE moving, update every one, then verify. Since framework-core has ts-rs codegen (per M8's finding), retarget its driver to the new `<owner>/🤖️generated/🟦️manifest.ts` path in the SAME change (do not leave it pointing at a stale relative path even momentarily) and update the corresponding `*-rs:check` target.
2. **Singletons (hash/editor/schema)**: "de-sandwiched in place" per the plan — meaning each just loses its `⚡️implementations/<lang>` sandwich wrapper and becomes `📦️packages/<lang>/` directly at its existing location, WITHOUT necessarily merging into framework-core or into each other (these are described as staying separate small singleton crates, just de-sandwiched). Confirm this reading against the plan's exact wording before deciding whether any of the three should actually merge with something else.

VERIFICATION: `cargo check --workspace` (this will be slow and touch many crates given 58 dependents — expect it, budget a long timeout, 600-900s), `cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2` (framework-core likely needs wasm-safety, check), `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` on your own new crate(s), `DEVELOPER_DIR=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools cargo test --lib` with baseline comparison. Confirm the ts-rs-generated manifest.ts content is IDENTICAL before/after (not just that it regenerates without error — diff the actual output). Run the registry taxonomy check.

CONSTRAINTS (non-negotiable, exclusive ownership of `🧰️framework/⚡️implementations/**`, the hash/editor/schema singleton dirs, and the 58 dependent files' import-path fixes ONLY — do not touch any dependent's OTHER content):
- Never touch root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, root package.json workspaces, nx.json, .storybook, .dependency-cruiser.cjs, the registry script/generated output, .vscode/launch.json, any plugin directory, or any OTHER framework family's directory (math, ui, compiler [skip], surface, assets, os/kernel/host).
- Never run git-modifying commands or use git worktrees.
- Do NOT use `run_in_background: true` for Bash — run synchronously with generous timeouts (600-900s given the 58-dependent blast radius).
- Delete any temporary verification overlay + nested target/Cargo.lock BEFORE closing your ticket.
- Add temporary files to your own ticket folder.
- When finished, call `mcp__repo__ticket_close` with a full summary and file list, plus a registrar-handoff block. Do not touch any other ticket.

Report back a concise summary of what moved, the ts-rs retarget decision, the 58-dependent repoint approach, and your verification results.
